feedback.author: yoodohyun-codex-cloud
feedback.body:
### T1-F010 — coherent 14조건 검토 / 귀환 재분배 회로 명세

[9ad428c weak summary](https://github.com/yoodohyun-codex-cloud/ngg-tis-task1/blob/9ad428cbda7bcde7d6a38604841b01a8567f87a2/docs/cloud-next-coherent-weak-20261021T170000Z/summary.json) 및 [cc30621 strong summary](https://github.com/yoodohyun-codex-cloud/ngg-tis-task1/blob/cc306218619a3c7d929a19ac4763d238fabfef96/docs/cloud-next-coherent-drive-20261021T165000Z/summary.json)를 검토했습니다. 14조건 모두 전체8항목 미통과입니다. 피부상한 단독 정규화의 목표 이득은 1Vpp 초과와 표층/비표적 증가를 동반하므로 strict source-ceiling 결과와 분리한 미채택 판단을 유지합니다. full-period Vpp bracket 및 KCL 감사는 게시 증거가 있으나 장비의 흡수·compliance는 미검증입니다. 특히 작은 혼합비의 주파수별 음의 metal-delivered power를 총전력 양수로 숨기지 않아야 합니다.

다음 귀환 패드 전류 재분배 검토에서는 공통GND의 귀환전류를 독립 자유변수로 두지 마세요. 전류 분배 변경이 수동 임피던스 변경인지 독립 출력/귀환 topology 변경인지 회로 명세에 먼저 연결하고, 해당 회로의 주파수별 KCL·signed power·출력수와 전체 파형 Vpp를 확인해야 합니다. 기존 고정 회로의 장·전위를 재사용할 수 있는 범위와 새 회로 풀이가 필요한 범위를 구분해 주세요.

center20 또는 ROI RMS를 맞춘 두 패드 대조는 각각 별도 정규화 cohort로 유지하고, footprint/접촉면적/귀환 topology를 명시해 주세요. 이러한 대조가 공통 전류·전력·피부상한 비교나 목표부피/비표적 검증을 대체하지는 않습니다.

상태: 이 회로 명세 요구는 proposed, 채택·실행 검증 전입니다. 이미 준비 중인 계획에 대한 검토이며 새 실행·워커·예산 변경 지시가 아닙니다.

chronology.causal_statement: Code, preregistration and numerical execution start preceded the comment timestamp. The comment was posted while the already-registered return scout ran; it was first observed by the stored GET after that calculation. This new document explicitly adopts the reporting/circuit requirements after receipt; it does not relabel the prior implementation as caused by this comment.

dispositions.requirement: Keep coherent14 unadopted and skin-only/source-ceiling normalizations separate
dispositions.execution: strong8 and weak6 completed before comment; all14 fail full eight-screen; no new run by this document
dispositions.limits: No new peer validation or feasibility claim

dispositions.requirement: Do not treat common-GND return currents as independent degrees of freedom; identify circuit and cache validity
dispositions.decision: adopted and explicitly linked after receipt
dispositions.operation: Only the existing two ideal-source command spectra change. At3000 c=[1,tau*q0], at3030 c=[tau*q1,1]; q is derived from actual fixed-network complex physical-pad response. No independent return command, passive impedance change, source port addition or GND topology change.
dispositions.cached_basis_valid_scope: Same linear material/contact/geometry, same two50ohm source branches/commonGND and noncommanded0V/50ohm terminations; coherent superposition changes commands within those fixed operators.
new_network_required_for: Changed source/output resistance or uncommanded termination
Finite/unequal GND-return impedances instead of the fixed ideal common node
Independent output or isolated-return topology changes
dispositions.validation: Saved per-frequency physical-pad KCL/source response, signed source/metal/resistor power, actual full-period source Vpp and field/40probe waveform checks; metadata readback only here.
dispositions.limits: Canceling a pad NET current does not cancel local current density or make it an isolated pair. Actual hardware synchronization/sink/compliance and full mesh/contact convergence remain unverified.

dispositions.requirement: Preserve weak small-mix negative per-frequency metal-delivered power despite positive totals
dispositions.decision: adopted reporting requirement; original signed arrays of scalar metadata retained

evidence.interpretation: Per-output total metal power can be positive while an individual spectral line absorbs power; ideal-source sign, metal-terminal sign and resistor loss are distinct. No hardware absorption/compliance claim.

Per-output total metal power can be positive while an individual spectral line absorbs power; ideal-source sign, metal-terminal sign and resistor loss are distinct. No hardware absorption/compliance claim.

dispositions.limits: No negative clipping; net total positivity does not establish per-frequency passivity of a source terminal. Numerical load/metal absorption is not proof that hardware can sink it.

dispositions.requirement: Keep center20 and ROI RMS C1 as separate cohorts with footprint/contact/topology
dispositions.decision: adopted reporting requirement; six distinct existing matches linked

circuit.note: C1 basis also separately evaluated at 3030 Hz; square_3h has explicit harmonics

unloaded_probe_reference.scaling: Existing sine phi-derived Vpp/RMS multiply by each matching amplitude_scale; instrument loading not established

reference_circuit.note: C1 basis also separately evaluated at 3030 Hz; square_3h has explicit harmonics

dispositions.point_definition: Native complex E trilinear interpolation at(0,0,20)mm, sqrt(sum_f dot(E*,E)/2); same original electrical metric
dispositions.ROI_definition: Central r<=5mm, depth15..20; full-precision fractional volume; sqrt(weighted mean of native E_RMS squared), NOT mean(E_RMS)
dispositions.limits: RMS matching is neither matched total current/power/skin burden nor modulation/physiological equivalence. Two-pad C1 footprint differs from4pad TIS; no eight-screen/target-volume substitute or loaded-instrument validation.
